title: Fix admin and History layout clips at narrow widths
request: Work on the still open tasks (admin defects at 320px, History edit toolbar clip at 640-669px, tablet score card wrap)

criteria.text: Season form (/admin/seasons, Create New Season): Cancel and Create Season buttons stay inside the card at 320px wide (the row wraps under 372px); before: Cancel left edge at x=-19.6, off screen
Timeslots (/admin/timeslots): card content stays inside its card at 320px; before: grid column 279.8px in a 238px card

Batch Matches date button (/admin/batch-matches): the whole date is inside the button at 320px, and the small (yyyy-mm-dd) copy never sticks out of the button at any width from 320 to 1280px; before: the copy stuck out 26.7px at every width, and at 320px the button was cut 34px
Confirm dialogs (Activate and Archive season): title and the confirm button are reachable at 320x844 and 320x640; before: Activate dialog 949px tall in an 844px screen
Auto-Schedule tabs (Auto-Loaded Teams / Manual Assignment): labels do not overlap at 320px (they wrap under 345px); before: overlap 11.1px
Pending Scores card footer (/admin/pending-matches): the Reject and Approve buttons stay inside the card at 320px (the footer wraps under 359px); before: 6.9px past the border
Scores entry row (/admin/scores): the Mark as final row and its badges stay inside the match box at 320px (the row wraps under 359px); before: badges 8px past the box
Create Team form (/admin/teams): the fields, Cancel and Create Team stay inside the card at 320px; before: the single column was 269.6px wide in a 238px card (Create Team 6.6px past the card border)
Update Logos card (/admin/teams): the Add Logo icon and label stay inside the button at 320px (the label wraps under 355px); before: spill 8.7px

History edit toolbar (/history, Edit Divisions, with unsaved changes): Save Changes is fully visible and inside the toolbar from 640 to 700px wide (the drag hint shows from 700px, not 640px); before: 29.9px past the toolbar at 640px

At 390px and 1280px, and at every width above each fix's limit, each touched screen measures the same before and after. Named exceptions: the batch date copy (hidden under 440px; the button grows to 284px from 440px) and the History drag hint (hidden at 640-699px). No new console errors, no sideways page scroll, existing tests pass, and the 2 new tests fail on the old code

reviews.summary: Plan review: line/class check VERIFIED. Lead is revising the plan.

notes.text: Criteria 1,3,5,6,7,8,9,10,11 were reworded BY HAND in this file (the CLI cannot reword). Reason: measurement during the build changed what each fix does (each wrap is limited to the narrow widths where the defect is, so 390px and wider stay identical; the batch date hint stuck out at every width, not only 320px; the History fix hides the drag hint 640-699px instead of re-flowing the buttons). Original wording is in the commit that opened the task (ade4f54).
